item.title: On the rise: Another victim speaks out after alleged Billings contractor scam
item.description: A Billings homeowner is speaking out after being scammed by a landscaping contractor who took her money and disappeared, leaving promised work unfinished.

item.title: Q2 Billings Area Weather: Chilly mix of morning sun & afternoon clouds on Friday
item.description: It looked and felt more like February and winter in Montana and Wyoming late Wednesday and Thursday as colder air and snow settled over the area. We'll have quiet, but chilly weather on Friday.

item.title: After complaints and shutoffs, Billings faces class action over water billing
item.description: Five Billings residents have filed a proposed class action lawsuit against the City of Billings, alleging they and other customers were charged "grossly inflated" water bills.
